_schema: Entries are summary-only Knowledge Items. The 'file' field is omitted once the raw log has been purged (agents.md §4 definitive_amnesia) — the 1-line summary IS the retained knowledge.

items.summary: Language violations and tool failures in Session 96AD.
Global interpreter execution violation: failed to prefix python script with venv/bin.

Terminology sweeps must use case-insensitive grep — a case-sensitive pass missed multiple ALL-CAPS runtime print strings (e.g. hooks/on_commit.py's log prefixes, legacy_app_auditor.py's status banners) during Phase 015's rename.

Renaming a skill directory desyncs generate_manifest.py's category/tags (it preserves curated fields by matching the old manifest entry's name, which no longer matches post-rename) — restore them manually after regeneration, don't assume the regenerated entry is complete.
git mv fails with "source directory is empty" on directories holding only untracked files; verify with git ls-files before choosing git mv vs plain mv during a folder rename.
Editing docs/active_state.json directly (not via a workflow step) leaves .agent_state/mirror.json stale — always re-run hooks/state_mirror.py after any manual edit to the active state.

Counting membership in a frontmatter list needs word boundaries, not a substring grep: `grep -qE 'Write|Edit'` over a `tools:` line also matches TodoWrite in agents/principal_agent.md, whose role explicitly does not write, returning 9 where the answer is 8.

A low-entropy secret fixture (a repeated character run) or a documented placeholder (AWS's …EXAMPLEKEY) is rejected by hooks/on_commit.py's credibility filter, so testing a secret-gate finding with either yields a false negative that looks exactly like the finding reproducing — use real-shaped random key material.

An artifact's risk is the cost of its assertions being wrong, not the difficulty of writing it: Sprint 023's C8 was ten checkbox ticks in Markdown, classified low-risk, and cost 5 gate rounds and 4 rejections that were all false claims, while C7 (a git mv) cleared both gates in one round.
PLACEHOLDER_MARKERS includes "test", so an ENV API_KEY="…test…" Dockerfile never trips on_commit; for real violation exercises use opaque non-placeholder values.

A tool-specific measurement receipt left in the sprint directory (e.g. cursor_mdc_schema.md) fails blind portability partition; absorb the contract into the product generator and remove the receipt before A3.

CRITICAL/HIGH work outside a sprint is RA-03: branch hotfix/[H-ID] (never fix/), docs/hotfixes/ before the first commit; agents.md used to name only the doc path so an agent opened fix/github-release-in-deploy for H-003.

Under session_tool cursor, Model/Effort in task_scope must come from make cursor-tiers (token_economy_agent proposes, rule_validator transcribes) — never Claude haiku/sonnet/opus aliases, and never as columns on agent_assignment.md (agent_orchestrator assigns profiles only).
